# Boots synthesis
isobutylbenzene (1)
-> 1-[4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl]ethanone (2), AcCl, AlCl3
-> ethyl 3-methyl-3-[4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl]oxirane-2-carboxylate (3), ClCH2CO2Et, NaOEt
-> 2-[4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl]propanal (4), H3O⁺, heat
-> CC(C)Cc1ccc(cc1)C(C)C=NO (5), NH2OH
-> 2-[4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl]propanenitrile (6), Ac2O
-> ibuprofen (7), H3O⁺
# BHC synthesis
1
-> 2, Ac2O, HF
-> 1-[4-(2-methylpropyl)phenyl]ethanol (8), H2, Raney Ni
-> 7, CO, Pd catalyst
